keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Fiorentina 1, Juventus 0. Mateo Pellegrino (Fiorentina) header from very close range to the top right corner. Assisted by Pote with a cross following a corner.
Juan Cabal (Juventus) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match (Juventus).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match (Juventus).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Bremer (Juventus) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Fiorentina 1, Juventus 1. Nick Woltemade (Juventus) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Randal Kolo Muani following a fast break.
First Half ends, Fiorentina 1, Juventus 1.
Delay in match because of an injury Jhon Lucumí (Juventus).
Delay in match because of an injury Mateo Pellegrino (Fiorentina).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Christ Inao Oulaï (Fiorentina) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Fiorentina 2, Juventus 1. Alieu Njie (Fiorentina) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner following a set piece situation.
Substitution, Juventus. Zeki Çelik replaces Juan Cabal.
Substitution, Juventus. Edon Zhegrova replaces Nick Woltemade.
Substitution, Juventus. Kerim Alajbegovic replaces Jérémie Boga.
Substitution, Fiorentina. Marco Brescianini replaces Pote.
Substitution, Fiorentina. Nicolò Fagioli replaces Christ Inao Oulaï.
Goal! Fiorentina 2, Juventus 2. Bremer (Juventus) with an attempt from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Douglas Luiz with a cross following a corner.
Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Juventus. Jeff Ekhator replaces Weston McKennie.
Substitution, Fiorentina. Beto replaces Mateo Pellegrino.
Substitution, Fiorentina. Wilfried Gnonto replaces Alieu Njie.
Substitution, Juventus. Federico Gatti replaces Jhon Lucumí.
